label: late-episode ramp modulated by belief (S2-good up at GO), prev a2/unrewarded, D2 state S1
terms: (phase == GO) * np.tanh(belief_lo) * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == D2) * np.tanh(belief_lo) * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == D1) * in_rew * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == D1) * np.tanh(belief_lo) * np.exp(ep_trial/20)
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 17 sits near -1 early in the episode and ramps strongly late (timing alone R^2 0.90); all deviations beyond timing scale with that ramp, so every term is multiplied by exp(ep_trial/20) (unscaled terms gave only 0.12 dev). At GO it is higher when the ideal-observer belief favours S2 (negative belief_lo), after a previous a2 choice, and lower after a rewarded previous trial (largest: up after a2 S2 u, down after a1 S1 r). At D2 the sign flips: higher when belief favours S1 and when the reached state is S1 (the choice itself adds ~nothing once state is in). At D1 small effects: up with the shown reward, slightly up when belief favours S2. Observed-only, no model outputs or future variables. Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.353, test 0.328, above the additive all ceiling 0.25 (all observed 0.22) thanks to the episode-time scaling; the policy-decile reference alone was 0.15, so dropping model outputs costs little. Remaining error is mostly window-level offsets late in the episode (whole windows sitting above/below prediction), not captured by trial history.
